[Intro]
[F]
[Bb]

[Verse 1]
[F]True that I saw her hair like the branch of a tree
A willow dancing on air before covering me
[Bb]Under cotton and calicoes
Over canopy dappled long a-
[F]go
True that love in withdrawal was the weeping of me
That the sound of the saw must be known by the tree
[Bb]Must be felled for to fight the cold
Fretted fire but that was long a-
[F]go

[Chorus]
[F]It's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where I'm set alight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And I blink in sight [Dm][C]
[Bb]Of your blinding light
[F]Oh, it's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where you hold me tight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And the fire bright [Dm][C]
[Bb]Oh, let it blaze alright
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me, [F]Oh, you're [Bb]good to me
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me,

[Interlude]
[F]baby
[Bb]

[Verse 2]
[F]With the roar of the fire, my heart rose to its feet
Like the ashes of ash, I saw rise in the heat
[Bb]Settled soft and as pure as snow
I fell in love with the fire long a-
[F]go
With each love I cut loose, I was never the same
Watching stillliving roots be consumed by the flame
[Bb]I was fixed on your hand of gold
Laying waste to my loving long a-
[F]go

[Chorus]
[F]It's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where I'm set alight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And I blink in sight [Dm][C]
[Bb]Of your blinding light
[F]Oh, it's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where you hold me tight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And the fire bright [Dm][C]
[Bb]Oh, let it blaze alright
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me, [F]Oh, you're [Bb]good to me
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me,

[Interlude]
[Dm]baby [Bb]
[Dm]  [Gm]  [Bb]

[Verse 3]
[F]So in awe, there I stood as you licked off the grain
Though I've handled the wood, I still worship the flame
[Bb]As long as amber of ember glows
All the "would" that I'd loved is long a-
[F]go

[Chorus]
[F]It's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where I'm set alight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And I blink in sight [Dm][C]
[Bb]Of your blinding light
[F]It's not tonight [Dm][Bb]
[F]Where you hold me tight [Dm][Bb]
[F]And the fire bright [Dm][C]

[Outro]
[F]Oh, you're [Bb]good to me, [F]Oh, you're [Bb]good to me
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me, [F]Oh, oh, [Bb]oh, oh, oh,
[F]You're good [Bb]to me [F]You're good [Bb]to me
[F]Oh, but you're [Bb]good to me,
[F]baby

[Fade Out]
